• Brand introduction:

Welcome to MiLi - Innovating Everyday Life

At MiLi, we believe in the power of technology to simplify, enhance, and transform everyday experiences. Founded with a vision to blend innovation with practicality, MiLi creates smart, stylish, and intuitive products that seamlessly integrate into your daily routine, making life easier, more secure, and more enjoyable.

Our Mission

Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high-quality tech products that empower individuals to stay connected, organized, and in control. Whether you’re at home, on the go, or exploring the world, MiLi products are your reliable companions, helping you navigate life with confidence and ease.

Why Choose MiLi?

  • Innovation at Our Core: We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology, creating products that are not only cutting-edge but also user-friendly and accessible to everyone.
  • Design Meets Functionality: Every MiLi product is crafted with both aesthetics and utility in mind. We believe that technology should enhance your life without compromising on style.
  • Quality You Can Trust: Our products are built to last, offering durability, reliability, and performance you can count on. We stand by our commitment to quality with rigorous testing and top-notch customer support.
  • A Connected Lifestyle: From smart trackers to wireless charging solutions, MiLi products are designed to keep you connected to the things that matter most, whether it’s your devices, your belongings, or your loved ones.

Our Products

MiLi’s product lineup includes a range of innovative solutions designed to fit your modern lifestyle:

  • MiTag: Bluetooth trackers that ensure you never lose sight of your valuables.
  • MiLock: Smart, TSA-approved locks that keep your luggage secure and trackable.
  • MiBell: Trackable bicycle bells with a distinctive copper ring, perfect for urban adventurers.
  • MiBook: A sleek, trackable passport wallet, ideal for the modern traveler.

 
• Product description: 

MiTag - The Ultimate Smart Tracker for Your Valuables

Never lose track of your valuables again with MiTag, the sleek and powerful Bluetooth tracker designed to keep your most important items safe and sound. Whether you're at home, at work, or traveling the world, MiTag ensures that your keys, luggage, wallet, or any other personal item is always within reach.

Key Features:

  • Compact & Lightweight: MiTag's slim design fits seamlessly into your lifestyle, easily attaching to your keys, slipping into your wallet, or attaching to your luggage without adding any bulk.
  • Precision Tracking: Using advanced Bluetooth technology, MiTag provides accurate and real-time location updates via the apple find my app.
  • Proximity Alerts: Receive instant notifications if you leave an item behind, ensuring you never misplace your belongings again.
  • Long Battery Life: With a battery that lasts up to a year, MiTag is built to be reliable, requiring minimal maintenance.
  • Community Find: Lost your item? Harness the power of the MiLi community to help locate your belongings, even when they're out of Bluetooth range.
  • Sleek Design: Available in a range of stylish colors, MiTag is as fashionable as it is functional, complementing your personal style.

Why MiTag?

In today's fast-paced world, losing track of your essentials can be a major inconvenience. MiTag offers peace of mind by keeping you connected to the things that matter most. Whether you're securing your luggage on a business trip or keeping tabs on your keys during a busy day, MiTag is your go-to solution for stress-free tracking.


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

USP #1

MiTag is an Apple Licensed Product, the company MiLi is an Apple partner

USP #2

It works with the Apple iOS Find My App

USP #3

It is half the price of an AirTag, and works just as well

USP #4

Comes with a free leather keychain holder, replaceable batteries

USP #5

It's IPX67 Waterproof

USP #6

Use the entire Apple network to locate your items

USP #7

Can use it to track: car, keys, wallet, etc.
